purpose: Prevent recursive self-hosting source growth from making parameter/local capacities stale. The exact final source is independently recounted, then compared with native Stage1 measurements from the exact same source/artifact. A capacity edit invalidates the evidence and requires a new measurement on the resulting source bytes.

independent_source_inventory.parameters_total: sum of parameters on every declared function, including foreign declarations
independent_source_inventory.local_declarations_total: count of VariableDeclaration AST nodes in the exact source
independent_source_inventory.source_sha256: SHA256 of the exact source bytes

selection_policy.BANKED: capacity may exceed required only because of the declared bank layout; headroom must be exact and dispatch/roundtrip proofs must PASS

fail_closed_if: measurement source SHA or byte count differs from current source
parameter required count differs from independent source recount
local required count differs from independent VariableDeclaration recount
BANKED lane lacks complete bank layout, dispatch proof or roundtrip proof
source or capacity changed after the measurement
fewer than two native measurements exist for the exact same source/artifact
overflow/truncation occurred on the canonical compile
overflow guard probe did not fail closed
